spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('quarter', $__timeFrom()::timestamp),
    date_trunc('quarter', $__timeTo()::timestamp),
    interval '3 months'
  )::date AS q
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    q.q,
    COUNT(c.org_unit_id) AS total,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status_at_end_of_interval = 'controlled' THEN 1 END), 0) AS controlled,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status_at_end_of_interval = 'uncontrolled' THEN 1 END), 0) AS uncontrolled,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status_at_end_of_interval = 'missed visit' THEN 1 END), 0) AS no_visit
  FROM quarters q
  LEFT JOIN HEART360_COHORT_PATIENT_DETAILS c
    ON c.registration_quarter = q.q
    AND c.org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
  WHERE q.q + interval '6 months'
    <= date_trunc('month', to_timestamp(${reference_month}/1000.0)) + interval '1 month'
  GROUP BY q.q
)
SELECT
  'Q' || EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM q)::int || '-' || EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q)::int || ' cohort' AS cohort_label,
  to_char(total, 'FM999,999,999') || CASE WHEN total = 1 THEN ' patient' ELSE ' patients' END AS patients_label,
  'Q' || EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM q + interval '3 months')::int || '-'
    || EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q + interval '3 months')::int AS result_quarter,
  ROUND(100.0 * controlled / NULLIF(total, 0), 2) AS controlled_h,
  ROUND(100.0 * uncontrolled / NULLIF(total, 0), 2) AS uncontrolled_h,
  ROUND(100.0 * no_visit / NULLIF(total, 0), 2) AS no_visit_h,
  CASE WHEN total > 0 AND 100.0 * controlled / total >= 5
       THEN ROUND(100.0 * controlled / total)::int || '%' ELSE '' END AS controlled_lbl,
  CASE WHEN total > 0 AND 100.0 * uncontrolled / total >= 5
       THEN ROUND(100.0 * uncontrolled / total)::int || '%' ELSE '' END AS uncontrolled_lbl,
  CASE WHEN total > 0 AND 100.0 * no_visit / total >= 5
       THEN ROUND(100.0 * no_visit / total)::int || '%' ELSE '' END AS no_visit_lbl,
  to_char(controlled, 'FM999,999,999') AS controlled_n,
  to_char(uncontrolled, 'FM999,999,999') AS uncontrolled_n,
  to_char(no_visit, 'FM999,999,999') AS no_visit_n
FROM counts
ORDER BY q
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    child_ou.id as child_id,
    child_ou.name as child_name,
    build_drill_url(child_ou.id) as drill_url,
    CASE WHEN child_ou.level >= 5 THEN
      '/d/heart360_facility?var-Region=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 1), '') ||
      '&var-District=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 2), '') ||
      '&var-Facility=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 3), '') ||
      '&var-Sub_Facility=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 4), '')
    ELSE NULL END as facility_url,
    SUM(COALESCE(uc.nb_patients_under_care, 0)) AS nb_patients_under_care,
    SUM(COALESCE(nb_new_patients, 0)) AS nb_patients_newly_registered,
    SUM(cat.nb_patients_controlled) AS nb_patients_controlled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cat.nb_patients_controlled) / NULLIF(GREATEST(0, SUM(cat.TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)), 0)) AS per_patients_controlled,
    SUM(cat.nb_patients_uncontrolled) AS nb_patients_uncontrolled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cat.nb_patients_uncontrolled) / NULLIF(GREATEST(0, SUM(cat.TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)), 0)) AS per_patients_uncontrolled,
    SUM(cat.nb_patients_no_visit) AS nb_patients_no_visit,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cat.nb_patients_no_visit) / NULLIF(GREATEST(0, SUM(cat.TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)), 0)) AS per_patients_no_visit
FROM HEART360_PATIENTS_CATEGORY cat
JOIN org_unit_lineage lin ON cat.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id
JOIN org_units child_ou ON lin.ancestor_id = child_ou.id AND child_ou.parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ((SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), '') LIMIT 1))
LEFT JOIN heart360_patients_registered
    ON cat.ref_month = heart360_patients_registered.ref_month
    AND cat.org_unit_id = heart360_patients_registered.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN HEART360_PATIENTS_UNDER_CARE uc
    ON cat.ref_month = uc.ref_month
    AND cat.org_unit_id = uc.org_unit_id
WHERE cat.ref_month = (
    SELECT MAX(ref_month) FROM HEART360_PATIENTS_CATEGORY
    WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
    AND $__timeFilter(ref_month)
)
GROUP BY child_ou.id, child_ou.name, child_ou.level
ORDER BY child_ou.name
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH latest_month AS (
    SELECT MAX(ref_month) AS ref_month FROM HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_CONTROLLED
    WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
    AND $__timeFilter(ref_month)
)
SELECT
    child_ou.id AS child_id,
    child_ou.name AS child_name,
    build_drill_url(child_ou.id) AS drill_url,
    SUM(COALESCE(uc.nb_dm_patients_under_care, 0)) AS nb_patients_under_care,
    SUM(COALESCE(uc.nb_new_dm_patients, 0)) AS nb_patients_newly_registered,
    SUM(COALESCE(bsc.diabetes_controlled, 0)) AS nb_patients_controlled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(bsc.diabetes_controlled, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(bsc.diabetes_patients_under_care, 0)), 0)) AS per_patients_controlled,
    SUM(COALESCE(bss.uncontrolled_moderate, 0) + COALESCE(bss.uncontrolled_high, 0)) AS nb_patients_uncontrolled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(bss.uncontrolled_moderate, 0) + COALESCE(bss.uncontrolled_high, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(bss.diabetes_patients_under_care, 0)), 0)) AS per_patients_uncontrolled,
    SUM(COALESCE(bsm.missed_visit, 0)) AS nb_patients_no_visit,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(bsm.missed_visit, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(bsm.diabetes_patients_under_care, 0)), 0)) AS per_patients_no_visit
FROM org_unit_lineage lin
JOIN org_units child_ou ON lin.ancestor_id = child_ou.id AND child_ou.parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ((SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), '') LIMIT 1))
LEFT JOIN HEART360_DM_PATIENTS_UNDER_CARE uc ON uc.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id AND uc.ref_month = (SELECT ref_month FROM latest_month)
LEFT JOIN HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_CONTROLLED bsc ON bsc.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id AND bsc.ref_month = (SELECT ref_month FROM latest_month)
LEFT JOIN HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_SEVERITY bss ON bss.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id AND bss.ref_month = (SELECT ref_month FROM latest_month)
LEFT JOIN HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_MISSED_VISITS bsm ON bsm.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id AND bsm.ref_month = (SELECT ref_month FROM latest_month)
GROUP BY child_ou.id, child_ou.name
ORDER BY child_ou.name
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
  patient_id,
  patient_name,
  registration_date,
  birth_date,
  gender,
  phone_number,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = h.org_unit_id) AS facility,
  last_visit_date,
  last_bp_diastolic,
  last_bp_systolic,
  last_call_date,
  last_call_result AS result_type,
  COALESCE(removed_reason, 'Pending to call') AS removed_reason,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(birth_date)) AS age_years,
  to_char(registration_date, 'FMDD Mon, YYYY') AS registration_label,
  to_char(last_visit_date, 'FMDD Mon, YYYY')
    || CASE WHEN last_visit_date::time <> '00:00'
         THEN E'\n' || lower(to_char(last_visit_date, 'FMHH12:MI AM')) ELSE '' END AS last_visit_label,
  to_char(last_call_date, 'FMDD Mon, YYYY') AS last_contacted_label,
  (CURRENT_DATE - last_visit_date::date) AS days_since_last_visit,
  CASE
    WHEN last_bp_systolic IS NOT NULL AND last_bp_diastolic IS NOT NULL
      THEN CONCAT(
        last_bp_systolic::int,
        '/',
        last_bp_diastolic::int
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS last_bp
FROM HEART360_OVERDUE_PATIENTS h
WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
  AND last_visit_date < now() - interval '45 days'
  AND ${selected_level} IN (3, 4, 10)
ORDER BY (CURRENT_DATE - last_visit_date::date) DESC
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT
    to_char(s.eligible_adults, 'FM999,999,999') AS eligible_n,
    to_char(s.screened_adults, 'FM999,999,999') AS screened_n,
    to_char(s.suspected_htn, 'FM999,999,999') AS suspected_n,
    ROUND(100.0 * s.screened_adults / NULLIF(s.eligible_adults, 0))::int AS screened_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * s.suspected_htn / NULLIF(s.eligible_adults, 0))::int AS suspected_pct,
    s.screening_target_pct AS target_pct,
    to_char(${estimated_htn_population}::numeric, 'FM999,999,999') AS estimated_n,
    to_char(COALESCE(t.registered, 0), 'FM999,999,999') AS registered_n,
    to_char(COALESCE(t.under_care, 0), 'FM999,999,999') AS under_care_n,
    to_char(COALESCE(t.controlled, 0), 'FM999,999,999') AS controlled_n,
    ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(t.registered, 0) / NULLIF(${estimated_htn_population}::numeric, 0))::int AS registered_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(t.under_care, 0) / NULLIF(${estimated_htn_population}::numeric, 0))::int AS under_care_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(t.controlled, 0) / NULLIF(${estimated_htn_population}::numeric, 0))::int AS controlled_pct,
    to_char(to_timestamp(${reference_month}/1000.0) - interval '1 month', 'Mon YYYY') AS month_label
  FROM demo_screening_cascade s
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      SUM(reg.cumulative_number_of_patients)::numeric AS registered,
      SUM(cat.nb_patients_under_care_registered_before_the_past_3_months)::numeric AS under_care,
      SUM(cat.nb_patients_controlled)::numeric AS controlled
    FROM heart360_patients_category cat
    JOIN heart360_patients_registered reg
      ON reg.ref_month = cat.ref_month AND reg.org_unit_id = cat.org_unit_id
    WHERE cat.ref_month = to_timestamp(${reference_month}/1000.0) - interval '1 month'
      AND cat.org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
  ) t ON TRUE
  WHERE s.id = 1
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.title: Hypertension treatment outcomes
spec.description: **Numerator for BP controlled:** Patients with BP <140 AND <90 at their latest visit in the past 3 months. **Numerator for BP not controlled:** Patients with BP >=140 OR >=90 at their latest visit in the past 3 months. **Numerator for no visit in 3 months:** Patients with no visit in the past 3 months. **Denominator:** Patients with hypertension registered before the past 3 months. Dead and 12 month lost to follow-up patients are excluded. Big numbers are the latest completed month; the current month is dashed.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
  ref_month,
  SUM(nb_patients_controlled) AS controlled_n,
  SUM(nb_patients_uncontrolled) AS uncontrolled_n,
  SUM(nb_patients_no_visit) AS no_visit_n,
  GREATEST(0, SUM(TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS) - SUM(NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED)
    - SUM(NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)) AS denominator_n
FROM HEART360_PATIENTS_CATEGORY
WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
GROUP BY ref_month
ORDER BY ref_month
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.title: DM treatment outcomes
spec.description: **Numerator for blood sugar controlled:** RBS <140, FBS <126 mg/dL or HbA1c <7% at the latest visit in the past 3 months. **Numerator for blood sugar not controlled:** FBS 126-199 mg/dL or HbA1c 7-8.9% (moderate), and FBS >=200 mg/dL or HbA1c >=9% (high), at the latest visit in the past 3 months. **Numerator for no visit in 3 months:** Patients with no visit in the past 3 months. **Denominator:** Patients with diabetes registered before the past 3 months. Dead patients and 12 month lost to follow-up patients are excluded. Figures are the latest completed month; the current month is dashed or faded.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH ctl AS (
  SELECT ref_month, SUM(diabetes_controlled) AS controlled_n, SUM(diabetes_patients_under_care) AS denominator_n
  FROM HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_CONTROLLED WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
  GROUP BY ref_month
), sev AS (
  SELECT ref_month, SUM(uncontrolled_moderate) AS moderate_n, SUM(uncontrolled_high) AS high_n
  FROM HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_SEVERITY WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
  GROUP BY ref_month
), mv AS (
  SELECT ref_month, SUM(missed_visit) AS no_visit_n
  FROM HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_MISSED_VISITS WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
  GROUP BY ref_month
)
SELECT ctl.ref_month, ctl.controlled_n, sev.moderate_n, sev.high_n, mv.no_visit_n, ctl.denominator_n
FROM ctl
LEFT JOIN sev ON sev.ref_month = ctl.ref_month
LEFT JOIN mv ON mv.ref_month = ctl.ref_month
ORDER BY ctl.ref_month
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

SELECT flags.*, pts.* FROM (
SELECT
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF('${selected_level}',''),'0')::int IN (3, 4, 10) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "isAccessible",
  COALESCE(NULLIF('$isAllowed', ''), '0')::int AS "isAllowed",
  '${requiredGroups}' AS "requiredGroups" 
) flags LEFT JOIN (
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
  patient_id::text AS patient_id,
  patient_name,
  registration_date,
  birth_date,
  gender,
  phone_number,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = h.org_unit_id) AS facility,
  last_visit_date,
  last_bp_diastolic,
  last_bp_systolic,
  last_call_date,
  last_call_result AS result_type,
  COALESCE(removed_reason, 'Pending to call') AS removed_reason,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(birth_date)) AS age_years,
  to_char(registration_date, 'FMDD Mon, YYYY') AS registration_label,
  to_char(last_visit_date, 'FMDD Mon, YYYY')
    || CASE WHEN last_visit_date::time <> '00:00'
         THEN E'\n' || lower(to_char(last_visit_date, 'FMHH12:MI AM')) ELSE '' END AS last_visit_label,
  to_char(last_call_date, 'FMDD Mon, YYYY') AS last_contacted_label,
  (CURRENT_DATE - last_visit_date::date) AS days_since_last_visit,
  CASE
    WHEN last_bp_systolic IS NOT NULL AND last_bp_diastolic IS NOT NULL
      THEN CONCAT(
        last_bp_systolic::int,
        '/',
        last_bp_diastolic::int
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS last_bp,
  (SELECT string_agg(option, '|' ORDER BY sort) FROM (
SELECT * FROM (
select 'Pending to call' as option, 1 as sort
union select 'Agreed to visit', 2
union select 'Call again later', 3
union select 'Already visited puskesmas', 4
union select 'Multiple failed contact attempts', 5
union select 'Wrong phone number', 6
union select 'Moved out of catchment area', 7
union select 'Transferred to another puskesmas', 8
union select 'Refused to return', 9
union select 'Died', 10
union select 'Other reason', 11
order by sort
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1' AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.is_central_node', true), 'false') <> 'true'
) o) AS status_options,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')) AS place,
  (SELECT string_agg(CASE pd.diagnosis_code WHEN 'I10' THEN 'HTN' ELSE 'DM' END, '|' ORDER BY pd.diagnosis_code DESC)
     FROM patient_diagnoses pd WHERE pd.patient_id = h.patient_id AND pd.diagnosis_code IN ('I10', 'E11')) AS conditions,
  (h.removed_reason IS NULL) AS never_contacted
FROM HEART360_OVERDUE_PATIENTS h
WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
  AND last_visit_date < now() - interval '45 days'
  AND ${selected_level} IN (3, 4, 10)
ORDER BY (CURRENT_DATE - last_visit_date::date) DESC
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'
) pts ON TRUE

spec.title: Overdue patients
spec.description: **Overdue at the start of the month:** alive patients whose last visit was more than the overdue period before the 1st of the month and who were not removed from the overdue list, the same rule as the Overdue list. The big number counts those with a phone number (8 or more digits). **Overdue patients called:** overdue patients with a phone number whose first call of the month was made in that month. **Overdue patients that returned to care:** patients called in the month who had a visit within 15 days of their first call, out of all patients called that month (as in the hearts360 0.3.9 charts). Big numbers are the latest completed month; the current month is dashed. Months before the first recorded call show no call figures.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
          WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
          LIMIT 1) AS org_id
),
units AS (
  SELECT id FROM org_units WHERE (SELECT org_id FROM sel) IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids((SELECT org_id FROM sel))
),
months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz),
                         date_trunc('month', $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
                         interval '1 month')::date AS ref_month
),
called AS (
  SELECT ref_month, SUM(overdue_patients_called) AS called_n
  FROM HEART360_OVERDUE_PATIENTS_CALLED
  WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM units)
  GROUP BY ref_month
),
returned AS (
  SELECT ref_month, SUM(overdue_returned_to_care) AS returned_n
  FROM HEART360_OVERDUE_RETURNED_TO_CARE
  WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM units)
  GROUP BY ref_month
),
first_call AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', MIN(call_date))::date AS ref_month FROM call_results
)
SELECT
  m.ref_month,
  r.overdue_n,
  r.overdue_with_phone_n AS overdue_phone_n,
  r.called_n AS called_overdue_n,
  COALESCE(c.called_n, 0) AS called_n,
  COALESCE(rt.returned_n, 0) AS returned_n,
  (m.ref_month >= (SELECT ref_month FROM first_call)) AS calls_recorded
FROM months m
CROSS JOIN LATERAL report_calling(m.ref_month, (SELECT org_id FROM sel)) r
LEFT JOIN called c ON c.ref_month = m.ref_month
LEFT JOIN returned rt ON rt.ref_month = m.ref_month
WHERE r.is_selected
ORDER BY m.ref_month
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 'Protocol adherence at ' || COALESCE((SELECT ou.name::text FROM org_units ou WHERE ou.id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int), 'all locations')
       || ': medicines at the latest visit up to the end of ' || to_char((date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month')::date, 'FMMonth YYYY') || '.' AS line
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.title: Patients by protocol step
spec.description: The Excel protocol adherence table. Each patient is counted once, by the BP medicines at their latest visit up to the end of the month. Shaded rows are totals. Counted patients were registered before the last 3 months and visited in the last 3 months. Controlled means BP below 140/90 at that visit. Cumulative control adds up each step's share of controlled patients on a step.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH r AS (
  SELECT * FROM report_adherence_steps((date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month')::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int, false)
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN r.step_no IS NOT NULL THEN E'\u2003\u2003' || r.label ELSE r.label END AS "Medicines at latest visit",
  r.patients_n AS "Number of patients",
  r.patients_pct AS "% of all patients",
  r.step_share_pct AS "% of patients on any protocol step",
  CASE WHEN r.row_key <> 'no_htn_medicine' THEN r.cohort_n END AS "Patients counted (registered before the last 3 months)",
  CASE WHEN r.row_key <> 'no_htn_medicine' THEN r.cohort_controlled_n END AS "Controlled",
  CASE WHEN r.row_key <> 'no_htn_medicine' THEN r.cohort_controlled_pct END AS "% controlled",
  r.controlled_share_cum_pct AS "Cumulative control by step"
FROM r
ORDER BY r.row_order
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 'Titration at ' || COALESCE((SELECT ou.name::text FROM org_units ou WHERE ou.id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int), 'all locations') || ', ' || to_char((date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month')::date - interval '8 months', 'FMMonth YYYY')
       || ' to ' || to_char((date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month')::date, 'FMMonth YYYY') || ', with the average of all places.' AS line
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.title: Titration rate by month
spec.description: Share of follow-up visits by patients with uncontrolled BP where the BP medicine was stepped up. Average is all places together.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH r AS (
  SELECT * FROM report_titration_monthly((date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month')::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) WHERE is_selected
)
SELECT month_date::timestamp AS "time", org_unit_name AS metric, rate_pct AS value FROM r
UNION ALL
SELECT month_date::timestamp, 'Average', average_rate_pct FROM r
ORDER BY 1, 2
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.title: Titration by month
spec.description: The Metabase titration table: the place's months first, then the average of all places.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH r AS (
  SELECT * FROM report_titration_monthly((date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month')::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) WHERE is_selected
)
SELECT "Month", "Place", "Follow-up visits", "Titrated", "Titration rate" FROM (
  SELECT 1 AS k, month_date, to_char(month_date, 'FMMonth YYYY') AS "Month", org_unit_name AS "Place",
         follow_up_n AS "Follow-up visits", titrated_n AS "Titrated", rate_pct AS "Titration rate"
  FROM r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2, month_date, to_char(month_date, 'FMMonth YYYY'), 'Average',
         average_follow_up_n, average_titrated_n, average_rate_pct
  FROM r
) t
ORDER BY k, month_date
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 'Systolic readings of 130–149 at ' || COALESCE((SELECT ou.name::text FROM org_units ou WHERE ou.id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int), 'all locations') || ', by quarter, '
       || min(quarter_label) FILTER (WHERE is_complete AND quarter_start = lo) || ' to '
       || min(quarter_label) FILTER (WHERE is_complete AND quarter_start = hi) || '.' AS line
FROM (
  SELECT q.*, min(q.quarter_start) FILTER (WHERE q.is_complete) OVER () AS lo,
              max(q.quarter_start) FILTER (WHERE q.is_complete) OVER () AS hi
  FROM report_fudging_quarterly((date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month')::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) q
) x
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.title: Systolic 130–139 and 140–149 readings by facility
spec.description: Readings with systolic BP 130–139 and 140–149 in each completed quarter. Ratio is 130–139 readings divided by 140–149 readings. Green is under 1.8, yellow from 1.8, red from 2.0. The first row is the place you chose. A blank ratio means too few readings.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT q.org_unit_name AS "Place", c.col AS "Column", c.val AS "Value"
FROM report_fudging_quarterly((date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month')::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) q
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  (1, q.quarter_label || ' 130–139', q.n_130_139::numeric),
  (2, q.quarter_label || ' 140–149', q.n_140_149::numeric),
  (3, q.quarter_label || ' Ratio', CASE WHEN NOT q.too_few THEN q.ratio END)
) AS c(k, col, val)
WHERE q.is_complete
ORDER BY NOT q.is_selected, q.org_unit_name, q.org_unit_id, q.quarter_start, c.k
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'
